description_excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE As a Customs Declarant, you will be responsible for preparing and filing customs declarations on the VNACCS/VCIS electronic system. You will ensure every filing is accurate, complete, timely, and fully compliant with Vietnamese customs regulations. This is a hands-on operational role suited for experienced customs practitioners who thrive in a fast-paced, accuracy-driven environment. You will handle complex commodity groups including pharmaceuticals, medical devices, high-tech electronics, FMCG, and other regulated products for diverse company types: Trading, Export…
